module_mood_contract: Joyful creation — "it works, on my repo." M1 Ex1 is the map-the-window move; the full "it works" spike is Ex2's job. Ex1 plants Theme 3 (mirror) + Theme 4 (self-aware, grain of salt) + Theme 1 (90% correct) experientially without resolving into the fix.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Meta-frame lectures are closers, not openers.
rules_evaluated.evidence: orient-and-introspect.md is a curriculum/exercises/ file, not a curriculum/lectures/ file; check_lectures.md's placement rules govern lecture files only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No cross-module sequencing in lecture bodies.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a lecture file. (Note, non-blocking: this pass cut the exercise's own arc-handoff sentence — 'the next exercise fixes the bug you brought from prework' — from the body; the maintainer block's Arc bullet still carries it. This is an exercise-file editorial choice, not governed by this lecture-scoped rule.)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide/lecture headers pass the squint test AND the truth clause.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This rule's numbered scope is lecture/handbook headers; slide-header squint/truth checking for exercise files runs under check_slides.md (a different class), not here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slide's BODY is size-bounded, not just its header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Slide-body sizing is check_slides.md's rule and class; check_lectures.md §5 states the rationale but the enforcement/verdict belongs to the slides class, not storytelling.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named; mood-floor 8+/10 on teaching beats.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Trace phase 1 mood_score 8, close mood_score 8 — single-phase teaching beat (interrogating Claude's read against /context), no beat below 7. Diagnostic (could this compress to a parenthetical without breaking the arc?) fails — the read/introspect/spot-check/context sequence IS the exercise, so mood-floor correctly applies and is met.

Lines 42-43 and the maintainer-attested 10%-heuristic line frame the self-report's unreliability as a working prior to hold loosely ('Could be more or less than this heuristic suggests'), not as a student mistake or shame. Per file's own maintainer note, this phrasing is attested — do-not-edit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Title 'Orient and map the window' and section headers ('Read your repo deliberately', 'Ask what Claude skipped, and why') name the positive discipline (deliberate reading, introspection) rather than a failure word (e.g. 'avoid blind trust').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity (consolidates front-run check, module-to-module arc, Big Idea fidelity, mood-doesn't-resolve-early).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea 'the context window is not your codebase' and the target-not-gauge close match strategy doc line 155 verbatim in spirit ('/context reports what you are carrying; it cannot tell you whether it is the right load... do not teach the percentage as a fuel gauge'). No front-run: file never touches plan mode (strategy explicitly reserves plan-mode-at-depth for M2). Arc: maintainer block's Arc bullet names hand-off to fix-tests-first, matching strategy's Ex1-scopes-Ex2 chain ('Ex1's read scopes Ex2's fix'). Mood doesn't resolve early: close explicitly holds 'no fix yet, payoff still ahead' per trace — matches strategy's Ex1 artifact description ('the delta between Claude's self-report and /context', not a fix).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go; forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The three forcing moves (read the repo, ask what was skipped, run /context) each live in a fenced {{prompt:...}} include, not narrated in body prose. The expanded HOX callout under 'Read your repo deliberately' (interrupt/narrow/continue, plus the new stop-short + rescue-prompt sentence) is a legitimate body recovery callout for a fan-out-prone prompt (per §48's sibling pattern), not a body-authored forcing function.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body teaches work; trainer manages room — no authored conversation/pause cues.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'discuss with your neighbor', 'share what you noticed', or scheduled pause-cue sentences anywhere in the body. Every sentence is about the work (the read, the introspection, the context budget), not cohort management.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Per-exercise leap test — 3 observable Monday outcomes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer block's Leap test lists three falsifiable outcomes (runs /context unprompted with a scrollback falsifier, asks what Claude skipped before acting with a scrollback falsifier, spot-checks the self-report with a quote-back falsifier) — all named-verb, all observable, none an abstract competency claim.
